description: 12-digit Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) identity card or masked e-Aadhaar.
accepted_examples: Original Aadhaar Card
e-Aadhaar downloaded from UIDAI with verified digital signature
Aadhaar PVC card

description: Permanent Account Number card issued by the Income Tax Department of India.
accepted_examples: Physical laminated PAN Card
e-PAN card generated via NSDL/UTIITSL with QR code

description: State civil supplies card indicating family household details and BPL/APL/Antyodaya status.
accepted_examples: Telangana/AP Food Security Card (FSC)
White Ration Card
Smart Ration Card / e-Ration extract
typical_validity: Subject to state annual renewal or revision

description: Electoral Photo Identity Card issued by the Election Commission of India (ECI).
accepted_examples: Color Voter ID Card
e-EPIC downloaded from voters.eci.gov.in with QR code

description: Recent color photograph with white or light off-white background, frontal view, neutral expression.
accepted_examples: 3.5cm x 4.5cm color photo taken within last 6 months
Digital JPEG image under 50-100KB for online portals

description: Official certificate issued by Revenue Department / Tahsildar / MeeSeva certifying annual family income.
accepted_examples: Digitally signed MeeSeva / MeeSeva 2.0 Income Certificate with Application Number & Barcode
Revenue Tahsildar signed certificate
typical_validity: Usually 1 year from date of issue in Telangana / Andhra Pradesh

description: Certificate verifying SC / ST / BC / OBC caste identity issued by the competent revenue authority.
accepted_examples: Digitally signed Integrated Community Certificate from MeeSeva
Tahsildar approved Caste Certificate with Barcode
typical_validity: Permanent / Lifetime (unless sub-categorization rules change; OBC-NCL typically renewed annually)

description: Proof of continuous stay in the respective village, mandal, district or state.
accepted_examples: MeeSeva Residence Certificate
Tahsildar Nativity Certificate
Study Certificate for consecutive 7-year period (educational domicile)
typical_validity: Generally 1 to 5 years depending on state rules

description: Institutional study certificate indicating class, academic year, medium of instruction and admission record.
accepted_examples: Study/Bonafide Certificate on school/college official letterhead signed by Headmaster or Principal
Continuous 4-7 years study certificates for local candidate status
typical_validity: Valid for the academic year of admission

description: Front page of active savings bank account showing Account Number, IFSC code, and account holder name.
accepted_examples: First page of Nationalized / Scheduled Commercial Bank Passbook with branch stamp
Cancelled Cheque leaf with pre-printed applicant name
Recent 3 months computerised bank statement signed by branch manager
typical_validity: Current active bank account (Aadhaar NPCI seeded for DBT subsidies)

description: Certificate issued by Municipality, Gram Panchayat or Registrar of Births and Deaths.
accepted_examples: Digital Birth Certificate with QR code from MeeSeva / Municipal Corporation (GHMC, CDMA)
Hospital Institutional Birth Certificate endorsed by local registrar

description: Official record certifying demise of an individual issued by Municipal Corporation or Panchayat.
accepted_examples: Digitally signed Death Certificate from Registrar of Births and Deaths / MeeSeva

description: Secondary School Certificate showing student's full name, father's name, date of birth and roll number.
accepted_examples: Board of Secondary Education (Telangana / AP / CBSE / ICSE) Original Certificate / DigiLocker fetched Memo
typical_validity: Lifetime (standard proof of date of birth in India)

description: Title deed passbook issued by Revenue Department establishing agricultural land ownership rights.
accepted_examples: Dharani Passbook with Khata Number (Telangana)
e-Pattadar Passbook (Andhra Pradesh Meebhoomi)
1-B extract with ROR digital sign
typical_validity: Valid until land alienation, sale, or partition

description: Certificate from Registration & Stamps Dept indicating all registered transactions/encumbrances over a property for a specified period.
accepted_examples: Online digitally signed EC from IGRS Telangana (registration.telangana.gov.in) or AP IGRS
typical_validity: Valid for the transaction period requested (typically last 15-30 years)

description: Recent electricity consumption bill showing unique consumer service number (USCNO) and installation address.
accepted_examples: TSSPDCL / TSNPDCL / APCPDCL electricity bill paid within the last 2-3 months
Municipal Water Supply bill

description: Unique Disability ID card or SADAREM certificate certifying percentage and nature of permanent/temporary disability.
accepted_examples: UDID Card (swavlambancard.gov.in)
SADAREM Certificate issued by Medical Board with Assessment percentage
typical_validity: Permanent if lifelong disability; specified re-assessment date if temporary

description: Signed declaration by applicant stating facts under oath, on prescribed MeeSeva form or notary stamp paper.
accepted_examples: Prescribed MeeSeva application self-declaration section signed by applicant
Notarized affidavit on Non-Judicial stamp paper (Rs. 20 - 100)
typical_validity: Valid for the specific application purpose

description: Scanned copy of applicant's signature made with black/blue ink pen on clean white paper.
accepted_examples: Clear JPG image under 20-50KB with clear handwriting
Left-hand thumb impression (LTI) in case of non-literate applicant
